collection_request.completeness_claim: bounded source snapshot and declared six-series frame only
collection_request.reference_period_limit: none beyond explicit monthly period in package
collection_request.release_kind: First Eurostat euro-indicator publication of the specified monthly aggregate/reference period
collection_request.scope_logic: calendar author AND exact title AND dataset membership; expand each matching package into two aggregate geographical targets; monthly component only

configuration_history.decision: Official Q4 calendar and API dimensions inspected; six domains and two aggregates chosen before eligibility and random sampling. User fixed binary probability, market ban and approximately 30 randomly sampled accounts.
configuration_history.phase: exploratory source discovery before this configuration

configuration_history.decision: Initial services query H-N_STS returned no numeric observations. Official code label H-N_X_K and populated observations matched intended coverage; adopted H-N_X_K. Both responses retained. Unemployment age TOTAL is actual monthly-table code, rather than absent Y15-74 code.

H=14 days, D=2 hours, b=24 hours, 24-month history, fixed latest-snapshot anchor, closed-book supplied materials, EU27_2020 plus EA21. These are this demonstration settings, not universal PMAF requirements.

exceptions_and_records.early_release: if published before submission, mark contaminated and exclude
exceptions_and_records.freeze: local SHA-256 manifest and local UTC timestamp only
exceptions_and_records.missing_result: UNRESOLVED at resolution deadline; no invented outcome
exceptions_and_records.rule_violation: invalid with evidence; excluded count reported
exceptions_and_records.schedule_change: retain frozen original; defer affected question to a separately versioned bank before presentation, or exclude from this run; never move times silently

materials_and_access.input_snapshot: construction snapshots retained unchanged; no rolling refresh
materials_and_access.prediction_markets: prohibited, including republished probabilities, quotations, search summaries and market-derived datasets
materials_and_access.provided: question.md, account.json, data/history.csv, materials.md, local_rules.md, shared global_rules.md; no whole-bank browsing
materials_and_access.scope_of_control: session access only; prior human knowledge or pretrained model knowledge cannot be removed
materials_and_access.tools: local arithmetic/statistics/code permitted; tool versions and use must be recorded

objective.ability: Reasoning about future releases of monthly EU/euro-area aggregate macroeconomic statistics relative to a fixed historical anchor
objective.rationale: Six monthly headline indicators cover labour, output, prices and retail; illustrative restricted frame, not all European statistics.
objective.subjects: unspecified; future human or AI participants

quality_and_eligibility.reference_period_parser: English month plus year; Sept maps to September; quarterly suffix ignored only for monthly dataset

question_generation.anchor: latest nonmissing observation of identical series/geography in the archived construction snapshot; must precede target reference month
question_generation.anchor_revision: never update within this bank version
question_generation.comparison: decimal values as published; no inferred unrounded value
question_generation.event: target first-release published numeric value > frozen anchor

resolution_and_scoring.aggregation: equal-weight mean over valid resolved forecast records, separately per subject/condition; report planned, submitted, excluded and resolved counts
resolution_and_scoring.fallback: none: latest API value cannot substitute for missing first-publication evidence
resolution_and_scoring.source: official Eurostat euro-indicator release page/table for exact indicator, geography and reference month; archive first publication content
resolution_and_scoring.source_locator: calendar title + scheduled release date + target reference month + exact series dimensions; record actual document URL/hash/time at resolution
resolution_and_scoring.unresolved: null outcome and null score, never zero
resolution_and_scoring.vintage: first publication of target value; later corrections recorded separately

selection.dependence: record calendar package, release target and series cluster IDs; no independence assumption
selection.post_selection_material_failure: stop construction; preserve failure; no silent replacement
selection.shortfall: select all eligible and report achieved count; no synthetic padding

time_design.release_time_basis: Official first-release 11 am CET policy interpreted as Luxembourg civil time using calendar UI timezone. Feed allDay=true start time is not treated as verified UTC. Reconfirm before execution.
